name: Jefferson County, TN
findings: Jefferson County has 80 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Jefferson County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
34% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Jefferson County list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 45% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 48 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
